# Predaj dvoch susediacich stavebných pozemkov – Bratislava IV, Devín, Ulica Nad záhradami

> The subject of the offer is the sale of two adjacent building plots, south-west facing and situated on a slope, located in Bratislava IV, in the city district of Devín, on Nad záhradami Street. This is a newly developing residential area of family houses, offering peace and privacy, plenty of greenery, and excellent accessibility to the city centre of Bratislava.

## Fakta
- Typ: pozemok
- Druh nabídky: predaj
- Plocha: 1052 m²
- Stav: neuvedené
- Vlastnictví: neuvedené
- Lokalita: Nad záhradami, Bratislava
- Cena: 895 000 €
